material_changes: Promote abide by = accept/obey a rule, agreement, or decision to the main learner layer.
Reframe tolerate as the modern mostly-negative can't/cannot abide pattern.
Keep archaic/literary dwell or stay reference-only.

core_clusters.label_en: accept or obey a rule, agreement, or decision
be unable to tolerate or strongly dislike

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 在现代英语里主要出现在两个固定框架：abide by“遵守”，can't abide“受不了”
core_concept.core_meaning_en: in modern English, chiefly survives in abide by 'obey/accept' and can't abide 'cannot tolerate'
core_concept.mental_model_cn: 不要把 abide 当普通“忍受”动词裸用：优先识别 abide by 和 can't/cannot abide 两个骨架。
core_concept.mental_model_en: treat modern abide as construction-led: abide by versus can't/cannot abide

overrides.definition_cn: 遵守；遵循（规则、协议、决定等）
overrides.definition_en: to accept, obey, or act in accordance with a rule, agreement, decision, or instruction
overrides.sense_label_en: accept or obey a rule, agreement, or decision
overrides.usage_note: Formal/neutral and strongly construction-bound: normally abide by something.

overrides.definition_cn: （通常用于 can't/cannot/couldn't）无法忍受；非常不喜欢
overrides.definition_en: to be unable to tolerate or to strongly dislike someone or something, especially in can't/cannot abide
overrides.usage_note: Much more natural in negative frames such as can't/cannot abide than as a free positive verb.

demotion_reasons.sense:abide:f837d5d00d3b5dd9: Archaic/literary 'live or stay' use remains reference-only.

constructions.meaning_cn: 无法忍受某人/某事/做某事

material_changes: Make ability to do sth a first-class construction rather than only an incidental collocation.
Add the high-yield grammar boundary: ability takes a to-infinitive, not ability of doing.

core_clusters.label_en: the capacity or skill to do something

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 使人能够完成某事的能力、技能或潜力
core_concept.core_meaning_en: the capacity, skill, or power that makes someone able to do something
core_concept.mental_model_cn: ability 关注“能不能做到”的能力本身；后面最重要的语法出口是 to do。
core_concept.mental_model_en: the capacity behind being able to do something; its key complement is a to-infinitive

overrides.definition_cn: 能力；本领；做某事的能力
overrides.definition_en: the capacity, skill, or power to do something
overrides.sense_label_en: capacity or skill to do something
overrides.usage_note: Use ability to do something; not ability of doing something.

constructions.meaning_cn: 具备/培养/展现做某事的能力
constructions.pattern: have/develop/show the ability to do sth

material_changes: Keep capacity/opportunity and competent-person senses, but make be able to the organizing grammar construction.
Add the practical can boundary: be able to supplies inflected/non-finite slots where can cannot appear.

core_clusters.label_en: having the power, skill, means, time, or opportunity to do something

core_concept.core_meaning_cn: 具备完成某事所需要的能力、条件或机会；也可形容人能干
core_concept.core_meaning_en: having what is needed to do something, or describing a person as competent and skilled
core_concept.mental_model_cn: able 不是普通后置动词：核心骨架是 be able to do；它还能填 can 无法变形或无法出现的位置。
core_concept.mental_model_en: anchor it to be able to + verb; unlike can, the phrase can inflect and appear in non-finite slots

overrides.definition_cn: 能够的；有能力、条件或机会做某事的
overrides.definition_en: having the power, skill, means, time, or opportunity to do something
overrides.sense_label_en: having what is needed to do something
overrides.usage_note: Followed by a to-infinitive: be able to do something. Be able to can be used in tense/non-finite positions where modal can cannot.

constructions.learning_note: to-infinitive required; not *able do or *able doing.
